mil3.3.6:2.2: ghānenapi rūpaṁyeva → sotena pi rūpaṁ yeva (pts) | jivhāyapi rūpaṁyeva → ghānena pi rūpaṁ yeva (pts) | kāyenapi rūpaṁyeva → jivhāya pi rūpaṁ yeva (pts) | manasāpi rūpaṁyeva → kāyena pi rūpaṁ yeva (pts)
mil3.3.6:2.6: cakkhunāpi phoṭṭhabbaṁyeva phusitabbaṁ sotenapi → cakkhunā pi (pts) | ghānenapi phoṭṭhabbaṁyeva phusitabbaṁ jivhāyapi → sotena pi (pts) | manasāpi phoṭṭhabbaṁyeva → ghānena pi phoṭṭhabbaṁ yeva (pts)
mil3.3.6:2.7: sotenapi dhammaṁyeva vijānitabbaṁ ghānenapi → sotena pi (pts) | jivhāyapi dhammaṁyeva → ghānena pi dhammaṁ yeva (pts)
